title: More than 500 bagpipers will invade Avenida da Liberdade: the biggest St. Patrick’s Day ever comes to Lisbon
description: The 3rd edition of the Irish festival has grown and now lasts three days, with downtown Lisbon hosting 15 bands, a big concert in Rossio, and a Guinness panoramic bus leading the parade.

title: With over 30 activities and latte art workshops, the country’s largest coffee festival is coming to Lisbon.
description: With unlimited coffee tastings, Coffee Week will "flood" Lisbon with the aroma of this precious bean: tickets are already on sale starting at €10.

title: Franuí and Lotus Easter Eggs? Nat’elier combined everything into a pastel de nata, and this was the result
description: Chef João Batalha has done it again, transforming the traditional Portuguese pastry into two Easter eggs with different flavors. Shall we take a look?

title: Iñigo Quintero, the global phenomenon behind “Si No Estás,” comes to Lisbon: the Galician star will perform in the capital later this month.
description: Iñigo Quintero brings the "Si No Estás" phenomenon to Lisbon! Find out everything about the concert at LAV, ticket prices, and what to expect from the Galician star.
